source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #080C14; --surface: #111827; --surface-alt: #1D293A; --text: #EAF2FF; --muted: #B8C6D9; --primary: #60A5FA; --accent: #F472B6; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 10px; --gap: 40px; --blur: 26px; --nav-position: fixed; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Satoshi', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Cabinet Grotesk', sans-serif; } .services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap); } .service-card { position: relative; min-height: 280px; padding: 28px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); transition: transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease; } .service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-strong); }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

services_grid.content_strategy: compact spec cards with icons and SLA rows
